checks.sql: SELECT entity_id, count(*) FROM trajectory.main.demo_input GROUP BY entity_id ORDER BY entity_id

checks.name: Trajectory visit and trip reconstruction on bundled synthetic data
checks.sql: SELECT entity_id, duration_s, fix_count FROM trajectory.main.episodes((SELECT * FROM trajectory.main.demo_input)) WHERE episode_type='visit' ORDER BY entity_id

checks.name: Empty trajectory relation
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trajectory.main.episodes((SELECT * FROM trajectory.main.demo_input WHERE false))

checks.name: One history spans input batches and is unsorted
checks.sql:
SELECT entity_id, episode_type, duration_s, fix_count FROM trajectory.main.episodes((
SELECT 'many' entity_id, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' + i * INTERVAL '1 second' observed_at,
500010.0 x, 4100010.0 y FROM range(5001) t(i) ORDER BY i DESC)) ORDER BY entity_id, episode_id

checks.name: Input and output both span batches
checks.sql:
SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE episode_type='visit'), sum(fix_count) FILTER (WHERE episode_type='visit')
FROM trajectory.main.episodes((SELECT i::VARCHAR entity_id, observed_at, x, y
FROM trajectory.main.demo_input CROSS JOIN range(2501) t(i) WHERE entity_id='crossing' ORDER BY observed_at DESC, i))

checks.name: Join inferred visits to fleet records
checks.sql:
WITH fleet(entity_id, vehicle) AS (VALUES ('crossing', 'Van 7'), ('stopped', 'Van 9')),
episodes AS (SELECT * FROM trajectory.main.episodes((SELECT * FROM trajectory.main.demo_input)))
SELECT f.vehicle, e.duration_s, e.fix_count, e.interpolated_boundaries
FROM episodes e JOIN fleet f USING(entity_id) WHERE e.episode_type='visit' ORDER BY f.vehicle
